result.description: Compact desktop switch for controlling two computers from a single keyboard, mouse, and display. Supports dual HDMI inputs, USB peripheral sharing, and simple front-panel toggling for home offices, test benches, and small studio workstations. Designed for users who need convenient input switching rather than graphics acceleration or storage expansion.
